title: LIC CFO Sunil Agrawal resigns months after his term was extended to March 2027
summary: Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) informed the stock exchanges of a change in its senior management, with Chief Financial Officer (CFO) Sunil Agrawal resigning after more than four years in the role.
